   150	
   151	func (e *runnerFailure) Error() string { return e.message }
   152	
   153	func runnerFailureCode(err error) string {
   154		var exposure *secretguard.ExposureError
   155		if errors.As(err, &exposure) && exposure.Code == secretguard.ErrorCode {
   156			return secretguard.ErrorCode
   157		}
   158		if isContainmentError(err) {
   159			return "worker_containment_failed"
   160		}
   161		if _, suspended := runnerSuspendedTerminal(err); suspended {
   162			return "suspended"
   163		}
   164		var failure *runnerFailure
   165		if errors.As(err, &failure) && strings.TrimSpace(failure.code) != "" {
   166			return failure.code
   167		}
   168		return "runner_failed"
   169	}
   170	
   171	func (r *Runner) CapabilitySummary(ctx context.Context) (map[string]any, error) {
   172		if r.protocol != RunnerProtocolV2 {
   173			return map[string]any{
   174				"protocolVersion": map[string]any{"major": 1, "minor": 0},
   175				"legacy":          true,
   176			}, nil
   177		}
   178		providers := make(map[string]any, len(providerHostProviders))
   179		for _, provider := range providerHostProviders {
   180			descriptor, err := r.describeProviderHostV2(ctx, provider)
   181			if err != nil {
   182				return nil, fmt.Errorf("describe Provider Host for %s: %w", provider, err)
   183			}
   184			providers[provider] = descriptor
   185		}
   186		return map[string]any{
   187			"protocolVersion": map[string]any{"major": providerHostProtocolMajor, "minor": providerHostProtocolMinor},
   188			"legacy":          false,
   189			"providers":       providers,
   190		}, nil
   191	}
   192	
   193	func (r *Runner) describeProviderHostV2(ctx context.Context, provider string) (descriptor providerHostDescriptor, err error) {
   194		process, err := r.startProviderHostV2(ctx, nil, r.providerProbeExecutionID(), 1)
   195		if err != nil {
   196			return providerHostDescriptor{}, err
   197		}
   198		finished := false
   199		defer func() {
   200			if !finished {
   201				err = errors.Join(err, process.abort())
   202			}
   203		}()
   204		command := newProviderHostCommand(
   205			"worker-probe", 1, "Describe", "worker-probe:"+provider,
   206			map[string]any{"provider": provider},
   207		)
   208		terminal, err := process.executeContext(ctx, command, nil)
   209		if err != nil {
   210			return providerHostDescriptor{}, err
   211		}
   212		descriptor, err = descriptorFromResult(terminal)
   213		if err != nil {
   214			return providerHostDescriptor{}, err
   215		}
   216		if err := r.validateProviderHostDescriptorWire(descriptor, provider); err != nil {
   217			return providerHostDescriptor{}, err
   218		}
   219		process.maximumCommandBytes = min(process.maximumCommandBytes, descriptor.MaximumCommandBytes)
   220		process.maximumMessageBytes = min(process.maximumMessageBytes, descriptor.MaximumMessageBytes)
   221		if err := process.finish(); err != nil {
   222			return providerHostDescriptor{}, err
   223		}
   224		finished = true
   225		return descriptor, nil
   226	}
   227	
   228	func (r *Runner) runProviderHostV2(
   229		ctx context.Context,
   230		input RunnerInput,
   231		credential *RunnerCredential,
   232		primary *RunnerPrimaryOperationControl,
   233		controls <-chan RunnerControl,
   234		handle func(context.Context, RunnerMessage) error,
   235	) (result RunnerResult, err error) {
   236		process, err := r.startProviderHostV2(
   237			ctx,
   238			credential,
   239			input.Execution.ID,
   240			input.Execution.Generation,
   241		)
   242		if err != nil {
   243			return RunnerResult{}, err
   244		}
   245		finished := false
   246		defer func() {
   247			if !finished {
   248				err = errors.Join(err, process.abort())
   249			}
   250		}()
   251	
   252		executionID := input.Execution.ID.String()
   253		generation := input.Execution.Generation
   254		provider := strings.TrimSpace(input.Workload.Provider)
   255		describe := newProviderHostCommand(
   256			executionID, generation, "Describe", commandID(input, "describe"),
   257			map[string]any{"provider": provider},
   258		)
   259		describeResult, err := process.executeContext(ctx, describe, nil)
   260		if err != nil {
   261			return RunnerResult{}, err
   262		}
   263		descriptor, err := descriptorFromResult(describeResult)
   264		if err != nil {
   265			return RunnerResult{}, err
   266		}
   267		if err := r.validateProviderHostDescriptorForExecution(descriptor, input, credential); err != nil {
   268			return RunnerResult{}, err
   269		}
   270		runtimeEventVersion, err := negotiateProviderHostRuntimeEventVersion(descriptor.RuntimeEventVersions)
   271		if err != nil {
   272			return RunnerResult{}, err
   273		}
   274		process.setRuntimeEventVersion(runtimeEventVersion)
   275		process.maximumCommandBytes = min(process.maximumCommandBytes, descriptor.MaximumCommandBytes)
   276		process.maximumMessageBytes = min(process.maximumMessageBytes, descriptor.MaximumMessageBytes)
   277	
   278		sessionCommand := "StartSession"
   279		if input.ProviderResumeCursor != nil || len(input.Workload.ConversationHistory) > 0 {
   280			sessionCommand = "ResumeSession"
   281		}
   282		start := newProviderHostCommand(
   283			executionID, generation, sessionCommand, commandID(input, "session"),
   284			map[string]any{"runnerInput": input, "runtimeEventVersion": runtimeEventVersion},
   285		)
   286		if _, err := process.executeContext(ctx, start, nil); err != nil {
   287			return RunnerResult{}, err
   288		}
   289	
   290		activeCommand, beforeWrite, primaryOperation, err := providerHostPrimaryCommand(
   291			ctx, input, runtimeEventVersion, primary,
   292		)
   293		if err != nil {
   294			return RunnerResult{}, err
   295		}
   296		activeExecution, err := process.startCommandBeforeWrite(ctx, activeCommand, func(message RunnerMessage) error {
   297			if handle == nil {
   298				return protocolFailure("Provider Host emitted a non-terminal message without a Worker handler")
   299			}
   300			return handle(ctx, message)
   301		}, beforeWrite)
   302		if err != nil {
   303			return RunnerResult{}, err
   304		}
   305		for {
   306			select {
   307			case outcome := <-activeExecution.result:
   308				if outcome.err != nil {
   309					return RunnerResult{}, outcome.err
   310				}
   311				result, err = runnerResultFromTerminal(outcome.message)
   312				if err != nil {
   313					return RunnerResult{}, err
   314				}
   315				if primaryOperation {
   316					result.PrimaryOperationResult = cloneProviderPayload(outcome.message.Payload)
   317				}
   318				if err := process.finish(); err != nil {
   319					return RunnerResult{}, err
   320				}
   321				finished = true
   322				return result, nil
   323			case control, open := <-controls:
   324				if !open {
   325					controls = nil
   326					continue
   327				}
   328				controlResult, controlErr := process.executeControlDetailed(
   329					ctx,
   330					input,
   700			return protocolFailure("Provider Host runtime without a version cannot be compatible")
   701		}
   702		return nil
   703	}
   704	
   705	func (r *Runner) validateProviderReleasePolicy(
   706		provider, supportTier string,
   707		policy providerReleasePolicy,
   708	) error {
   709		requiresExplicitEnablement := supportTier == "experimental"
   710		if policy.RequiresExplicitEnablement != requiresExplicitEnablement {
   711			return protocolFailure("Provider Host releasePolicy does not match its support tier")
   712		}
   713		expectedEnabled := true
   714		if requiresExplicitEnablement {
   715			expectedEnabled = r.experimentalProviderEnabled(provider)
   716		}
   717		if policy.Enabled != expectedEnabled {
   718			return &runnerFailure{
   719				code:                 "provider_version_incompatible",
   720				message:              "Provider Host enabled state does not match the Worker target Provider policy",
   721				requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true,
   722				canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   723			}
   724		}
   725		return nil
   726	}
   727	
   728	func validProviderSupportTier(value string) bool {
   729		switch value {
   730		case "tier-1", "tier-2", "experimental", "local-only":
   731			return true
   732		default:
   733			return false
   734		}
   735	}
   736	
   737	func negotiateProviderHostRuntimeEventVersion(versions providerHostVersionRange) (int, error) {
   738		if versions.Minimum <= providerHostRuntimeEventVersion && versions.Maximum >= providerHostRuntimeEventVersion {
   739			return providerHostRuntimeEventVersion, nil
   740		}
   741		return 0, &runnerFailure{
   742			code: "provider_version_incompatible", message: "Provider Host has no compatible Runtime Event version",
   743			requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true,
   744			canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   745		}
   746	}
   747	
   748	func (r *Runner) validateProviderHostDescriptorForExecution(
   749		descriptor providerHostDescriptor,
   750		input RunnerInput,
   751		credential *RunnerCredential,
   752	) error {
   753		if err := r.validateProviderHostDescriptorWire(descriptor, input.Workload.Provider); err != nil {
   754			return err
   755		}
   756		if descriptor.ProtocolVersion.Minor >= 1 {
   757			if descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.SupportTier == "experimental" &&
   758				(descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.ReleasePolicy == nil ||
   759					!descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.ReleasePolicy.RequiresExplicitEnablement ||
   760					!descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.ReleasePolicy.Enabled) {
   761				return &runnerFailure{
   762					code:               "capability_unsupported",
   763					message:            fmt.Sprintf("Experimental Provider %s is disabled by the Worker target policy", input.Workload.Provider),
   764					requiresUserAction: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   765				}
   766			}
   767			runtime := descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.Runtime
   768			if runtime == nil || !runtime.Available {
   769				return &runnerFailure{
   770					code:               "provider_not_installed",
   771					message:            fmt.Sprintf("Provider runtime for %s is unavailable on this Worker", input.Workload.Provider),
   772					requiresUserAction: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   773				}
   774			}
   775			if !runtime.Compatible {
   776				return &runnerFailure{
   777					code:                 "provider_version_incompatible",
   778					message:              fmt.Sprintf("Provider runtime version for %s is unavailable or outside the compatible range", input.Workload.Provider),
   779					requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true,
   780					canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   781				}
   782			}
   783		}
   784		capabilityID := "send-turn"
   785		if operation := input.Workload.PrimaryOperation; operation != nil {
   786			switch operation.CommandType {
   787			case "CompactSession":
   788				capabilityID = "compact"
   789			case "StartReview":
   790				capabilityID = "review"
   791			default:
   792				return protocolFailure("Execution workload requested an unsupported primary Provider operation")
   793			}
   794		}
   795		capability := descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.Capabilities[capabilityID]
   796		if descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.SupportTier == "local-only" ||
   797			(capability != "native" && capability != "emulated") {
   798			return &runnerFailure{
   799				code:               "capability_unsupported",
   800				message:            fmt.Sprintf("Provider %s does not support capability %s on this remote Provider Host", input.Workload.Provider, capabilityID),
   801				requiresUserAction: true,
   802			}
   803		}
   804		requiresProviderCLIVersion := descriptor.ProtocolVersion.Minor < 1
   805		if runtime := descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.Runtime; runtime != nil && runtime.Kind == "cli" {
   806			requiresProviderCLIVersion = true
   807		}
   808		if requiresProviderCLIVersion &&
   809			(descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.ProviderCLIVersion == nil ||
   810				strings.TrimSpace(*descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.ProviderCLIVersion) == "" ||
   811				strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(*descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.ProviderCLIVersion), "unavailable")) {
   812			return &runnerFailure{
   813				code:               "provider_not_installed",
   814				message:            fmt.Sprintf("Provider CLI for %s is unavailable on this Worker", input.Workload.Provider),
   815				requiresUserAction: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   816			}
   817		}
   818		if credential != nil && !containsString(descriptor.CredentialDeliveryMode, "anonymous-fd") {
   819			return &runnerFailure{
   820				code:                 "credential_missing",
   821				message:              "Provider Host does not support the required anonymous credential descriptor",
   822				requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   823			}
   824		}
   825		if input.ProviderResumeCursor != nil && !containsString(descriptor.ResumeStrategies, "native-cursor") &&
   826			len(input.Workload.ConversationHistory) == 0 {
   827			return &runnerFailure{
   828				code:                 "session_resume_invalid",
   829				message:              "Provider Host cannot resume from the persisted Provider Cursor",
   830				requiresNewExecution: true, canReconstructFromHistory: false, canMoveWorker: true,
   831			}
   832		}
   833		if len(input.Workload.ConversationHistory) > 0 && !containsString(descriptor.ResumeStrategies, "authoritative-history") &&
   834			(input.ProviderResumeCursor == nil || !containsString(descriptor.ResumeStrategies, "native-cursor")) {
   835			return &runnerFailure{
   836				code:                 "session_resume_invalid",
   837				message:              "Provider Host cannot reconstruct the Session from authoritative history",
   838				requiresNewExecution: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   839			}
   840		}
   841		return nil
   842	}
   843	
   844	func runnerResultFromTerminal(message providerHostMessage) (RunnerResult, error) {
   845		if message.MessageType != "Result" {
   846			return RunnerResult{}, protocolFailure("Provider operation did not return a Result message")
   847		}
   848		output := map[string]any{}
   849		if value, found := message.Payload["output"]; found {
   850			decoded, ok := value.(map[string]any)
   851			if !ok {
   852				return RunnerResult{}, protocolFailure("Provider operation Result output is not an object")
   853			}
   854			output = decoded
   855		}
   856		var cursor *string
   857		if value, found := message.Payload["providerResumeCursor"]; found {
   858			decoded, ok := value.(string)
   859			if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(decoded) == "" {
   860				return RunnerResult{}, protocolFailure("Provider operation Result providerResumeCursor is invalid")
   861			}
   862			cursor = &decoded
   863		}
   864		return RunnerResult{Output: output, ProviderResumeCursor: cursor}, nil
   865	}

   867	type providerHostV2Process struct {
   868		command             *exec.Cmd
   869		processTree         *processTree
   870		outputPipes         *processOutputPipes
   871		stdin               io.WriteCloser
   872		stderr              *boundedBuffer
   873		credentialWrite     <-chan error
   874		maximumCommandBytes int
   875		maximumMessageBytes int
   876		runtimeEventVersion int
   877	
   878		mu             sync.Mutex
   879		writeMu        sync.Mutex
   880		commands       map[string]*providerHostCommandState
   881		completed      map[string]providerHostCompletedCommand
   882		readerDone     chan struct{}
   883		closing        bool
   884		fatalErr       error
   885		waitOnce       sync.Once
   886		waitErr        error
   887		credentialOnce sync.Once
   888		credentialErr  error
   889	}
   890	
   891	func (p *providerHostV2Process) setRuntimeEventVersion(version int) {
   892		p.mu.Lock()
   893		p.runtimeEventVersion = version
   894		p.mu.Unlock()
   895	}

   897	type providerHostCommandOutcome struct {
   898		message providerHostMessage
   899		err     error
   900	}
   930	func (e *providerHostCommandExecution) wait() (providerHostMessage, error) {
   931		outcome := <-e.result
   932		return outcome.message, outcome.err
   933	}
   934	
   935	func (e *providerHostCommandExecution) waitContext(ctx context.Context) (providerHostMessage, error) {
   936		select {
   937		case outcome := <-e.result:
   938			return outcome.message, outcome.err
   939		case <-ctx.Done():
   940			return providerHostMessage{}, ctx.Err()
   941		}
   942	}
   943	
   944	func (r *Runner) startProviderHostV2(
   945		ctx context.Context,
   946		credential *RunnerCredential,
   947		executionID uuid.UUID,
   948		generation int64,
   949	) (*providerHostV2Process, error) {
   950		if len(r.command) == 0 {
   951			return nil, &runnerFailure{code: "provider_unavailable", message: "Provider Host command is empty", canMoveWorker: true}
   952		}
   953		arguments := append([]string(nil), r.command[1:]...)
   954		if !containsString(arguments, "--protocol-v2") {
   955			arguments = append(arguments, "--protocol-v2")
   956		}
   957		command := exec.Command(r.command[0], arguments...)
   958		processTree, err := newProcessTree(command, r.processTreeOptions(executionID, generation))
   959		if err != nil {
   960			return nil, &runnerFailure{
   961				code: "provider_unavailable", message: safeRunnerMessage("prepare Provider Host process tree: " + err.Error()),
   962				retryable: true, canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   963			}
   964		}
   965		processTreeOwned := false
   966		defer func() {
   967			if !processTreeOwned {
   968				_ = processTree.release()
   969			}
   970		}()
   971		command.Env = providerHostEnvironment(os.Environ(), r.experimentalProviderList())
   972		var credentialWrite <-chan error
   973		if credential != nil {
   974			readPipe, writePipe, err := os.Pipe()
   975			if err != nil {
   976				return nil, fmt.Errorf("open Provider Host credential pipe: %w", err)
   977			}
   978			command.ExtraFiles = []*os.File{readPipe}
   979			command.Env = append(command.Env, "SYNARA_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_FD=3")
   980			writeResult := make(chan error, 1)
   981			credentialWrite = writeResult
   982			go func() {
   983				defer close(writeResult)
   984				encoder := json.NewEncoder(writePipe)
   985				err := encoder.Encode(credential)
   986				if closeErr := writePipe.Close(); err == nil {
   987					err = closeErr
   988				}
   989				writeResult <- err
   990			}()
   991		}
   992		stdin, err := command.StdinPipe()
   993		if err != nil {
   994			closeProviderHostFiles(command)
   995			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open Provider Host stdin: %w", err)
   996		}
   997		stderr := &boundedBuffer{maximum: 64 << 10}
   998		outputPipes, err := newProcessOutputPipes(command, stderr)
   999		if err != nil {
  1000			_ = stdin.Close()
  1001			closeProviderHostFiles(command)
  1002			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open Provider Host output pipes: %w", err)
  1003		}
  1004		outputPipesOwned := false
  1005		defer func() {
  1006			if !outputPipesOwned {
  1007				outputPipes.close()
  1008			}
  1009		}()
  1010		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
  1011			_ = stdin.Close()
  1012			closeProviderHostFiles(command)
  1013			return nil, errors.Join(err, processTree.release())
  1014		}
  1015		if err := command.Start(); err != nil {
  1016			_ = stdin.Close()
  1017			closeProviderHostFiles(command)
  1018			startErr := &runnerFailure{
  1019				code: "provider_unavailable", message: safeRunnerMessage("start Provider Host: " + err.Error()),
  1020				retryable: true, canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
  1021			}
  1022			return nil, errors.Join(startErr, processTree.release())
  1023		}
  1024		if err := processTree.started(); err != nil {
  1025			_ = stdin.Close()
  1026			closeProviderHostFiles(command)
  1027			startErr := &runnerFailure{
  1028				code: "provider_unavailable", message: safeRunnerMessage("isolate Provider Host process tree: " + err.Error()),
  1029				retryable: true, canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
  1030			}
  1031			return nil, errors.Join(startErr, processTree.terminate(), command.Wait(), processTree.release())
  1032		}
  1033		outputPipes.started()
  1034		closeProviderHostFiles(command)
  1035		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(outputPipes.stdoutRead)
  1036		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 64*1024), r.maxMessageBytes)
  1037		process := &providerHostV2Process{
  1038			command: command, processTree: processTree, outputPipes: outputPipes, stdin: stdin, stderr: stderr,
  1039			credentialWrite: credentialWrite, maximumCommandBytes: providerHostCommandLimit,
  1040			maximumMessageBytes: r.maxMessageBytes,
  1041			commands:            make(map[string]*providerHostCommandState), completed: make(map[string]providerHostCompletedCommand),
  1042			readerDone: make(chan struct{}),
  1043		}
  1044		processTreeOwned = true
  1045		outputPipesOwned = true
  1046		go func() {
  1047			_ = process.waitProcess()
  1048			_ = process.processTree.terminate()
  1049		}()
  1050		go process.readLoop(scanner)
  1051		return process, nil
  1052	}
  1053	
  1054	func providerHostEnvironment(source []string, experimentalProviders []string) []string {
  1055		allowlist := make([]string, 0, len(runnerEnvironmentAllowlist)+len(providerHostProxyEnvironmentAllowlist))
  1056		allowlist = append(allowlist, runnerEnvironmentAllowlist...)
  1057		allowlist = append(allowlist, providerHostProxyEnvironmentAllowlist...)
  1058		result := selectProcessEnvironment(source, allowlist)
  1059		result = append(result, providerHostExperimentalEnv+"="+strings.Join(experimentalProviders, ","))
  1060		return result
  1061	}

  1063	func closeProviderHostFiles(command *exec.Cmd) {
  1064		for _, file := range command.ExtraFiles {
  1065			_ = file.Close()
  1180			return nil, ctx.Err()
  1181		}
  1182	}
  1183	
  1184	func (p *providerHostV2Process) discardPreparedCommand(state *providerHostCommandState, err error) {
  1185		p.mu.Lock()
  1186		owned := false
  1187		if current := p.commands[state.command.CommandID]; current == state {
  1188			delete(p.commands, state.command.CommandID)
  1189			owned = true
  1190		}
  1191		p.mu.Unlock()
  1192		if !owned {
  1193			return
  1194		}
  1195		state.result <- providerHostCommandOutcome{err: err}
  1196		close(state.result)
  1197	}
  1198	
  1199	func (p *providerHostV2Process) readLoop(scanner *bufio.Scanner) {
  1200		defer close(p.readerDone)
  1201		for scanner.Scan() {
  1202			line := bytes.TrimSpace(scanner.Bytes())
  1203			if len(line) == 0 {
  1204				continue
  1205			}
  1206			if err := p.handleLine(append([]byte(nil), line...)); err != nil {
  1207				p.fail(err)
  1208				break
  1209			}
  1210		}
  1211		if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
  1212			p.fail(protocolFailure("Provider Host emitted a malformed or oversized JSONL message"))
  1213		}
  1214		waitErr := p.waitProcess()
  1215		terminateErr := p.processTree.terminate()
  1216		p.outputPipes.waitStderr()
  1217		p.mu.Lock()
  1218		fatalErr := p.fatalErr
  1219		closing := p.closing
  1220		active := len(p.commands)
  1221		p.mu.Unlock()
  1222		if fatalErr != nil {
  1223			return
  1224		}
  1225		if terminateErr != nil {
  1226			p.fail(terminateErr)
  1227			return
  1228		}
  1229		if waitErr != nil {
  1230			p.fail(p.processFailure(waitErr))
  1231			return
  1232		}
  1233		if active > 0 {
  1234			p.fail(protocolFailure("Provider Host exited before emitting a terminal message"))
  1235			return
  1236		}
  1237		if !closing {
  1238			p.fail(protocolFailure("Provider Host exited before Worker shutdown"))
  1239		}
  1240	}
  1241	
  1242	func (p *providerHostV2Process) handleLine(line []byte) error {
  1243		message, err := p.decodeMessage(line)
  1244		if err != nil {
  1245			return err
  1246		}
  1247		p.mu.Lock()
  1248		state := p.commands[message.CommandID]
  1249		if state == nil {
  1250			_, completed := p.completed[message.CommandID]
  1251			p.mu.Unlock()
  1252			if completed {
  1253				return protocolFailure("Provider Host emitted output after the terminal message")
  1254			}
  1255			return protocolFailure("Provider Host message referenced an unknown commandId")
  1256		}
  1257		if err := validateProviderHostMessageCorrelation(message, state.command); err != nil {
  1258			p.mu.Unlock()
  1259			return err
  1260		}
  1261		switch message.MessageType {
  1262		case "Result", "Error":
  1263			outcome := providerHostCommandOutcome{message: message}
  1264			if message.MessageType == "Error" {
  1265				outcome.err = failureFromProviderHost(message.Error)
  1266			}
  1267			delete(p.commands, message.CommandID)
  1268			p.completed[message.CommandID] = providerHostCompletedCommand{command: state.command, outcome: outcome}
  1269			p.mu.Unlock()
  1270			state.result <- outcome
  1271			close(state.result)
  1272			return nil
  1273		case "Event", "ArtifactCandidate", "InteractionRequest", "Checkpoint", "Progress":
  1274			handle := state.handle
  1275			runtimeEventVersion := p.runtimeEventVersion
  1276			p.mu.Unlock()
  1277			if handle == nil {
  1278				return protocolFailure("Provider Host emitted a non-terminal message for a control command")
  1279			}
  1280			runnerMessage, err := runnerMessageFromProviderHost(message, runtimeEventVersion)
  1281			if err != nil {
  1282				return err
  1283			}
  1284			return handle(runnerMessage)
  1285		default:
  1286			p.mu.Unlock()
  1287			return protocolFailure("Provider Host emitted an unknown message type")
  1288		}
  1289	}
  1290	
  1291	func (p *providerHostV2Process) decodeMessage(line []byte) (providerHostMessage, error) {
  1292		if len(line) > p.maximumMessageBytes {
  1293			return providerHostMessage{}, protocolFailure("Provider Host message exceeds the negotiated size limit")
  1294		}
  1295		var message providerHostMessage
  1296		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &message); err != nil {
  1297			return providerHostMessage{}, protocolFailure("Provider Host emitted malformed JSONL")
  1298		}
  1299		if message.ProtocolVersion.Major != providerHostProtocolMajor {
  1300			return providerHostMessage{}, &runnerFailure{
  1301				code:                 "provider_version_incompatible",
  1302				message:              fmt.Sprintf("Provider Host message uses unsupported Protocol major %d", message.ProtocolVersion.Major),
  1303				requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true,
  1304				canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
  1305			}
  1306		}
  1307		if strings.TrimSpace(message.RequestID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(message.ExecutionID) == "" ||
  1308			message.Generation <= 0 || strings.TrimSpace(message.CommandID) == "" ||
  1309			strings.TrimSpace(message.OccurredAt) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(message.MessageType) == "" {
  1310			return providerHostMessage{}, protocolFailure("Provider Host message omitted required correlation fields")
  1311		}
  1312		if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, message.OccurredAt); err != nil {
  1313			return providerHostMessage{}, protocolFailure("Provider Host message occurredAt is invalid")
  1314		}
  1315		return message, nil
  1316	}
  1317	
  1318	func validateProviderHostMessageCorrelation(message providerHostMessage, command providerHostCommand) error {
  1319		if message.RequestID != command.RequestID || message.ExecutionID != command.ExecutionID ||
  1320			message.Generation != command.Generation || message.CommandID != command.CommandID {
  1321			return protocolFailure("Provider Host message correlation fields do not match the command")
  1322		}
  1323		return nil
  1324	}
  1325	
  1326	func (p *providerHostV2Process) finish() error {
  1327		p.mu.Lock()
  1328		if p.fatalErr != nil {
  1329			err := p.fatalErr
  1330			p.mu.Unlock()
  1331			return err
  1332		}
  1333		if len(p.commands) > 0 {
  1334			p.mu.Unlock()
  1335			return protocolFailure("Provider Host still has active commands during shutdown")
  1336		}
  1337		p.closing = true
  1338		p.mu.Unlock()
  1339		if err := p.stdin.Close(); err != nil {
  1340			return fmt.Errorf("close Provider Host stdin: %w", err)
  1341		}
  1342		<-p.readerDone
  1343		p.mu.Lock()
  1344		fatalErr := p.fatalErr
  1345		p.mu.Unlock()
  1346		if fatalErr != nil {
  1347			return errors.Join(fatalErr, p.releaseProcessResources())
  1348		}
  1349		if err := p.waitProcess(); err != nil {
  1350			return errors.Join(p.processFailure(err), p.releaseProcessResources())
  1351		}
  1352		if err := p.credentialResult(); err != nil {
  1353			return errors.Join(&runnerFailure{
  1354				code: "credential_invalid", message: "Provider credential could not be delivered to the Provider Host",
  1355				requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true, canMoveWorker: true,
  1356			}, p.releaseProcessResources())
  1357		}
  1358		return p.releaseProcessResources()
  1359	}
  1360	
  1361	func (p *providerHostV2Process) abort() error {
  1362		p.mu.Lock()
  1363		p.closing = true
  1364		p.mu.Unlock()
  1365		_ = p.stdin.Close()
  1366		terminateErr := p.processTree.terminate()
  1367		<-p.readerDone
  1368		_ = p.waitProcess()
  1369		_ = p.credentialResult()
  1370		return errors.Join(terminateErr, p.releaseProcessResources())
  1371	}
  1372	
  1373	func (p *providerHostV2Process) fail(err error) {
  1374		if err == nil {
  1375			return
  1376		}
  1377		p.mu.Lock()
  1378		if p.fatalErr != nil {
  1379			p.fatalErr = errors.Join(p.fatalErr, err)
  1380			p.mu.Unlock()
  1381			return
  1382		}
  1383		p.fatalErr = err
  1384		p.closing = true
  1385		states := make([]*providerHostCommandState, 0, len(p.commands))
  1386		for _, state := range p.commands {
  1387			states = append(states, state)
  1388		}
  1389		p.commands = make(map[string]*providerHostCommandState)
  1390		p.mu.Unlock()
  1391		for _, state := range states {
  1392			state.result <- providerHostCommandOutcome{err: err}
  1393			close(state.result)
  1394		}
  1395		_ = p.stdin.Close()
  1396		_ = p.processTree.terminate()
  1397	}
  1398	
  1399	func (p *providerHostV2Process) releaseProcessResources() error {
  1400		p.outputPipes.close()
  1401		return p.processTree.release()
  1402	}
  1403	
  1404	func (p *providerHostV2Process) waitProcess() error {
  1405		p.waitOnce.Do(func() { p.waitErr = p.command.Wait() })
  1406		return p.waitErr
  1407	}
  1408	
  1409	func (p *providerHostV2Process) credentialResult() error {
  1410		p.credentialOnce.Do(func() {
  1411			if p.credentialWrite != nil {
  1412				p.credentialErr = <-p.credentialWrite
  1413			}
  1414		})
  1415		return p.credentialErr
  1416	}
  1417	
  1418	func (p *providerHostV2Process) processFailure(err error) error {
  1419		message := strings.TrimSpace(p.stderr.String())
  1420		if message == "" {
  1421			message = err.Error()
  1422		}
  1423		return &runnerFailure{
  1424			code: "provider_unavailable", message: safeRunnerMessage("Provider Host failed: " + message),
  1425			retryable: true, requiresNewExecution: true, canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
  1426		}
  1427	}

    62	func LoadConfig() (Config, error) {
    63		rawURL := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("SYNARA_CONTROL_PLANE_URL"))
    64		parsedURL, err := url.Parse(rawURL)
    65		if err != nil || parsedURL.Scheme == "" || parsedURL.Host == "" || (parsedURL.Scheme != "http" && parsedURL.Scheme != "https") {
    66			return Config{}, errors.New("SYNARA_CONTROL_PLANE_URL must be an HTTP(S) origin")
    67		}
    68		targetID, err := uuid.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("SYNARA_EXECUTION_TARGET_ID")))
    69		if err != nil {
    70			return Config{}, errors.New("SYNARA_EXECUTION_TARGET_ID must be a UUID")
    71		}
    72		targetKind, err := platform.ParseExecutionTargetKind(os.Getenv("SYNARA_EXECUTION_TARGET_KIND"))
    73		if err != nil {
    74			return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("SYNARA_EXECUTION_TARGET_KIND: %w", err)
    75		}
    76		var sshBootstrapGeneration *int64
    77		rawSSHBootstrapGeneration := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_SSH_BOOTSTRAP_GENERATION"))
    78		if targetKind == platform.TargetSSH {
    79			value, parseErr := strconv.ParseInt(rawSSHBootstrapGeneration, 10, 64)
    80			if parseErr != nil || value <= 0 {
    81				return Config{}, errors.New("SYNARA_AGENTD_SSH_BOOTSTRAP_GENERATION must be a positive integer for SSH workers")
    82			}
    83			sshBootstrapGeneration = &value
    84		} else if rawSSHBootstrapGeneration != "" {
    85			return Config{}, errors.New("SYNARA_AGENTD_SSH_BOOTSTRAP_GENERATION is only valid for SSH workers")
    86		}
    87		runnerCommand, err := validation.CommandJSON(os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_RUNNER_COMMAND_JSON"))
    88		if err != nil {
    89			return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("SYNARA_AGENTD_RUNNER_COMMAND_JSON: %w", err)
    90		}
    91		runnerProtocol, err := parseRunnerProtocol(os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_PROVIDER_HOST_PROTOCOL"))
    92		if err != nil {
    93			return Config{}, err
    94		}
    95		cgroupV2Root, err := parseCgroupV2Root(os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_CGROUP_V2_ROOT"))
    96		if err != nil {
    97			return Config{}, err
    98		}
    99		cgroupV2ProviderIdentity, err := parseProtectedCgroupProviderIdentity(
   100			cgroupV2Root,
   101			os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_CGROUP_V2_PROVIDER_UID"),
   102			os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_CGROUP_V2_PROVIDER_GID"),
   103		)
   104		if err != nil {
   105			return Config{}, err
   106		}
   107		cgroupV2Attestation, err := parseProtectedCgroupAttestationConfig(
   108			cgroupV2Root,
   109			cgroupV2ProviderIdentity,
   110			os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_CGROUP_V2_ATTESTATION_KEY_ID"),
   111			os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_CGROUP_V2_ATTESTATION_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE"),
   112		)
   113		if err != nil {
   114			return Config{}, err
   115		}
   116		capabilities := map[string]any{}
   117		if raw := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("SYNARA_AGENTD_CAPABILITIES_JSON")); raw != "" {
   118			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &capabilities); err != nil || capabilities == nil {
   119				return Config{}, errors.New("SYNARA_AGENTD_CAPABILITIES_JSON must be a JSON object")
   120			}
   121		}
   122		delete(capabilities, resourceSuspendContainmentCapabilityKey)
   123		if err := validateWorkerImageBuildFeatureFlagReservation(capabilities); err != nil {
   124			return Config{}, err
   125		}
   126		experimentalProviders, err := parseExperimentalProviders(capabilities)
   127		if err != nil {
   128			return Config{}, err
   129		}
   130		workerImageManifest, err := loadConfiguredWorkerImageManifest()
   240		}
   241		if cfg.RunnerMessageBytes, err = intEnv("SYNARA_AGENTD_RUNNER_MESSAGE_BYTES", 1<<20); err != nil {
   242			return Config{}, err
   243		}
   244		if cfg.PollInterval <= 0 || cfg.HeartbeatInterval <= 0 || cfg.LeaseRenewInterval <= 0 || cfg.DrainTimeout <= 0 || cfg.RequestTimeout <= 0 || cfg.ArtifactTimeout <= 0 || cfg.RunnerMessageBytes < 1024 {
   245			return Config{}, errors.New("agentd intervals, request timeout, and runner message limit must be positive")
   246		}
   247		if cfg.ImageDigest != "" && !validImageDigest(cfg.ImageDigest) {
   248			return Config{}, errors.New("agentd image digest is invalid")
   249		}
   250		return cfg, nil
   251	}

   253	func effectiveWorkerMode(cfg Config) string {
   254		mode, err := resolveConfiguredWorkerMode(cfg.WorkerMode, cfg.AssignedExecutionID)
   255		if err != nil {
   256			if cfg.AssignedExecutionID != nil {
   257				return executions.WorkerModeExecutionPinned
   258			}
   259			return executions.WorkerModeGeneralPool
   260		}
   261		return mode
   262	}
   263	
   264	func resolveConfiguredWorkerMode(raw string, assignedExecutionID *uuid.UUID) (string, error) {
   265		mode := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
   266		if mode == "" {
   267			if assignedExecutionID != nil {
   268				return executions.WorkerModeExecutionPinned, nil
   269			}
   270			return executions.WorkerModeGeneralPool, nil
   271		}
   272		switch mode {
   273		case executions.WorkerModeExecutionPinned:
   274			if assignedExecutionID == nil {
   275				return "", errors.New("SYNARA_AGENTD_WORKER_MODE=execution-pinned requires SYNARA_AGENTD_ASSIGNED_EXECUTION_ID")
   276			}
   277		case executions.WorkerModeWarmPool, executions.WorkerModeGeneralPool:
   278			if assignedExecutionID != nil {
   279				return "", fmt.Errorf("SYNARA_AGENTD_WORKER_MODE=%s cannot be combined with SYNARA_AGENTD_ASSIGNED_EXECUTION_ID", mode)
   280			}
   281		default:
   282			return "", errors.New("SYNARA_AGENTD_WORKER_MODE must be execution-pinned, warm-pool, or general-pool")
   283		}
   284		return mode, nil
   285	}
   286	
   287	func parseCgroupV2Root(value string) (string, error) {
   288		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
   289		if trimmed == "" {
   290			return "", nil
   291		}
   292		if runtime.GOOS != "linux" {
   293			return "", errors.New("SYNARA_AGENTD_CGROUP_V2_ROOT is only supported on Linux workers")
   294		}
   295		if !filepath.IsAbs(trimmed) {
   296			return "", errors.New("SYNARA_AGENTD_CGROUP_V2_ROOT must be an absolute path")
   297		}
   298		normalized := filepath.Clean(trimmed)
   299		if normalized == string(filepath.Separator) {
   300			return "", errors.New("SYNARA_AGENTD_CGROUP_V2_ROOT must point at a delegated subtree, not /")
   301		}
   302		return normalized, nil
   303	}
   304	
   305	func parseProtectedCgroupProviderIdentity(
   306		cgroupV2Root, uidValue, gidValue string,

   450	
   451	func (d *Daemon) waitForDrain(
   452		parent context.Context,
   453		cancelRun context.CancelFunc,
   454		runDone <-chan struct{},
   455		drainMarked chan<- struct{},
   456	) {
   457		defer close(drainMarked)
   458		select {
   459		case <-parent.Done():
   460		case <-runDone:
   461			return
   462		}
   463		if !d.draining.CompareAndSwap(false, true) {
   464			return
   465		}
   466		d.logger.Info("agentd draining", "deadline", d.config.DrainTimeout)
   467		deadline := time.Now().Add(d.config.DrainTimeout)
   468		heartbeatTimeout := min(d.shutdownRequestTimeout(), time.Until(deadline))
   469		if heartbeatTimeout > 0 {
   470			heartbeatContext, cancelHeartbeat := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), heartbeatTimeout)
   471			if err := d.client.Heartbeat(heartbeatContext, d.config, true); err != nil {
   472				d.logger.Warn("worker Drain heartbeat failed", "error", err)
   473			}
   474			cancelHeartbeat()
   475		}
   476		remaining := time.Until(deadline)
   477		if remaining <= 0 {
   478			cancelRun()
   479			return
   480		}
   481		timer := time.NewTimer(remaining)
   482		defer timer.Stop()
   483		select {
   484		case <-timer.C:
   485			d.logger.Warn("agentd Drain deadline reached; cancelling the active Runner")
   486			cancelRun()
   487		case <-runDone:
   488		}
   489	}
   490	
   491	func (d *Daemon) heartbeatLoop(
   492		ctx context.Context,
   493		cancelRun context.CancelFunc,
   494		fatalErrors chan<- error,
   495	) {
   496		ticker := time.NewTicker(d.config.HeartbeatInterval)
   497		defer ticker.Stop()
   498		for {
   499			select {
   500			case <-ctx.Done():
   501				return
   502			case <-ticker.C:
   503				requestContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, d.config.RequestTimeout)
   504				err := d.client.Heartbeat(requestContext, d.config, d.draining.Load())
   505				cancel()
   506				if err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
   507					if isWorkerRevocationError(err) {
   508						select {
   509						case fatalErrors <- err:
   510						default:
   511						}
   512						cancelRun()
   513						return
   514					}
   515					d.logger.Warn("worker heartbeat failed", "error", err)
   516				}
   517			}
   518		}
   519	}
   520	
   521	func receiveWorkerFatalError(fatalErrors <-chan error) error {
   522		select {
   523		case err := <-fatalErrors:
   524			return err
   525		default:
   526			return nil
   527		}
   528	}

    20	type LocalSupervisorInput struct {
    21		ListenAddress     string
    22		RegistrationToken string
    23		ExecutionTargetID uuid.UUID
    24		Capabilities      map[string]any
    25		RunnerCommand     []string
    26		WorkspaceRoot     string
    27		GitCacheRoot      string
    28		WorkerLeaseTTL    time.Duration
    29		HeartbeatTimeout  time.Duration
    30		DrainTimeout      time.Duration
    31		RestartBackoff    time.Duration
    32	}
    33	
    34	type LocalSupervisor struct {
    35		config         Config
    36		restartBackoff time.Duration
    37		logger         *slog.Logger
    38		newDaemon      func(Config, *slog.Logger) daemonRunner
    39	}
    40	
    41	type daemonRunner interface {
    42		Run(context.Context) error
    43	}
    44	
    45	func NewLocalSupervisor(input LocalSupervisorInput, logger *slog.Logger) (*LocalSupervisor, error) {
    46		controlPlaneURL, err := localControlPlaneURL(input.ListenAddress)
    47		if err != nil {
    48			return nil, err
    49		}
    50		if strings.TrimSpace(input.RegistrationToken) == "" {
    51			return nil, errors.New("local agentd requires a worker registration token")
    52		}
    53		if input.ExecutionTargetID == uuid.Nil {
    54			return nil, errors.New("local agentd requires an execution target")
    55		}
    56		if len(input.RunnerCommand) == 0 {
    57			return nil, errors.New("local agentd requires a runner command")
    58		}
    59		workspaceRoot, err := filepath.Abs(strings.TrimSpace(input.WorkspaceRoot))
    60		if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(input.WorkspaceRoot) == "" {
    61			return nil, errors.New("local agentd workspace root is invalid")
    62		}
    63		gitCacheRoot := strings.TrimSpace(input.GitCacheRoot)
    64		if gitCacheRoot == "" {
    65			gitCacheRoot = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(workspaceRoot), "git-cache")
    66		}
    67		workspaceRoot, gitCacheRoot, err = validateWorkspaceRoots(workspaceRoot, gitCacheRoot)
    68		if err != nil {
    69			return nil, fmt.Errorf("local agentd storage roots are invalid: %w", err)
    70		}
    71		if input.WorkerLeaseTTL <= 0 || input.HeartbeatTimeout <= input.WorkerLeaseTTL {
    72			return nil, errors.New("local agentd lease and heartbeat durations are invalid")
    73		}
    74		restartBackoff := input.RestartBackoff
    75		if restartBackoff <= 0 {
    76			restartBackoff = time.Second
    77		}
    78		leaseRenewInterval := workertiming.LeaseRenewInterval(input.WorkerLeaseTTL)
    79		heartbeatInterval := input.HeartbeatTimeout / 3
    80		if heartbeatInterval < time.Second {
    81			heartbeatInterval = time.Second
    82		}
    83		capabilities := make(map[string]any, len(input.Capabilities)+1)
    84		for key, value := range input.Capabilities {
    85			capabilities[key] = value
    86		}
    87		if _, found := capabilities["workspaceModes"]; !found {
    88			capabilities["workspaceModes"] = []string{"local", "worktree"}
    89		}
    90		experimentalProviders, err := parseExperimentalProviders(capabilities)
    91		if err != nil {
    92			return nil, fmt.Errorf("local agentd target capabilities are invalid: %w", err)
    93		}
    94		config := Config{
    95			ControlPlaneURL: controlPlaneURL, RegistrationToken: input.RegistrationToken,
    96			ExecutionTargetID: input.ExecutionTargetID, TargetKind: platform.TargetLocal,
    97			ClusterID: "control-plane", Namespace: "local",
    98			PodName: "local-agentd-" + input.ExecutionTargetID.String(), InstanceUID: uuid.NewString(), Version: "embedded",
    99			Capabilities: capabilities, ExperimentalProviders: experimentalProviders,
   100			RunnerCommand: append([]string(nil), input.RunnerCommand...), RunnerProtocol: RunnerProtocolV2,
   101			WorkspaceRoot: workspaceRoot, GitCacheRoot: gitCacheRoot,
   102			PollInterval: time.Second, HeartbeatInterval: heartbeatInterval,
   103			LeaseRenewInterval: leaseRenewInterval, DrainTimeout: input.DrainTimeout, RequestTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
   104			ArtifactTimeout: 30 * time.Minute, RunnerMessageBytes: 1 << 20,
   105		}
   106		if config.DrainTimeout <= 0 {
   107			config.DrainTimeout = 10 * time.Second
   108		}
   109		return &LocalSupervisor{
   110			config: config, restartBackoff: restartBackoff, logger: logger,
   111			newDaemon: func(cfg Config, logger *slog.Logger) daemonRunner { return NewDaemon(cfg, logger) },
   112		}, nil
   113	}
   114	
   115	func (s *LocalSupervisor) Run(ctx context.Context) {
   116		for ctx.Err() == nil {
   117			err := s.newDaemon(s.config, s.logger).Run(ctx)
   118			if ctx.Err() != nil {
   119				return
   120			}
   121			s.logger.Error("local agentd stopped; restarting", "error", err, "backoff", s.restartBackoff)
   122			if !waitContext(ctx, s.restartBackoff) {
   123				return
   124			}
   125		}
   126	}
   127	
   128	func localControlPlaneURL(listenAddress string) (*url.URL, error) {
   129		host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(strings.TrimSpace(listenAddress))
   130		if err != nil {
   131			return nil, fmt.Errorf("derive local agentd URL from SYNARA_CONTROL_PLANE_LISTEN: %w", err)
   132		}
   133		if strings.TrimSpace(port) == "" {
   134			return nil, errors.New("derive local agentd URL from SYNARA_CONTROL_PLANE_LISTEN: port is empty")
   135		}
   136		if host == "" || host == "0.0.0.0" || host == "::" {
   137			host = "127.0.0.1"
   138		}
   139		return &url.URL{Scheme: "http", Host: net.JoinHostPort(host, port)}, nil
   140	}
   720		defer source.Close()
   721		return c.uploadArtifactSource(ctx, executionID, lease, artifact, source)
   722	}
   723	
   724	func (c *Client) uploadArtifactSource(
   725		ctx context.Context,
   726		executionID uuid.UUID,
   727		lease executions.Lease,
   728		artifact RunnerArtifact,
   729		source *artifactUploadSource,
   730	) (artifacts.Artifact, error) {
   731		contentType, err := normalizeRunnerArtifactContentType(artifact.ContentType)
   732		if err != nil {
   733			return artifacts.Artifact{}, err
   734		}
   735		artifact.ContentType = contentType
   736		identity, err := inspectArtifactUploadIdentity(ctx, executionID, lease, artifact, source)
   737		if err != nil {
   738			return artifacts.Artifact{}, err
   739		}
   740		var lastErr error
   741		createRequestID := artifactRequestID(executionID, lease, identity.IdempotencyKey, "create")
   742		completeRequestID := artifactRequestID(executionID, lease, identity.IdempotencyKey, "complete")
   743		maximumAttempts := 1
   744		if c.artifactIdempotencySupported {
   745			maximumAttempts = 3
   746		}
   747		for attempt := 1; attempt <= maximumAttempts; attempt++ {
   748			artifact, err := c.uploadArtifactAttempt(
   749				ctx, executionID, lease, artifact, source, nil, &identity,
   750				createRequestID, completeRequestID,
   751			)
   752			if err == nil {
   753				return artifact, nil
   754			}
   755			lastErr = err
   756			if ctx.Err() != nil {
   757				break
   758			}
   759		}
   760		return artifacts.Artifact{}, lastErr
   761	}

   764		ctx context.Context,
   765		executionID uuid.UUID,
   766		lease executions.Lease,
   767		checkpoint executions.WorkspaceCheckpoint,
   768		candidate WorkspaceCheckpointCandidate,
   769	) (artifacts.Artifact, error) {
   770		contentType, err := normalizeRunnerArtifactContentType(candidate.Artifact.ContentType)
   771		if err != nil {
   772			return artifacts.Artifact{}, err
   773		}
   774		artifact := *candidate.Artifact
   775		artifact.ContentType = contentType

   121		}
   122		if string(commands) != "Describe\nStartSession\nCompactSession\n" {
   123			t.Fatalf("unexpected primary operation command sequence %q", commands)
   124		}

   810		t.Setenv("PROVIDER_HOST_TEST_MODE", "success")
   811	
   812		summary, err := providerHostV2TestRunner().CapabilitySummary(context.Background())
   813		if err != nil {
   814			t.Fatal(err)
   815		}
   816		protocol, ok := summary["protocolVersion"].(map[string]any)
   817		if !ok || protocol["major"] != providerHostProtocolMajor || summary["legacy"] != false {
   818			t.Fatalf("unexpected Provider Host summary: %#v", summary)
   819		}
   820		providers, ok := summary["providers"].(map[string]any)
   821		if !ok || providers["codex"] == nil || providers["claudeAgent"] == nil {
   822			t.Fatalf("Provider Host summary omitted remote Providers: %#v", summary)
   823		}
   824		codex, ok := providers["codex"].(providerHostDescriptor)
   825		if !ok || codex.RuntimeEventVersions.Minimum != providerHostRuntimeEventVersion ||
   826			codex.RuntimeEventVersions.Maximum != providerHostRuntimeEventVersion || codex.ProtocolVersion.Minor < 1 ||
   827			codex.CapabilityDescriptor.Runtime == nil || codex.CapabilityDescriptor.ReleasePolicy == nil ||
   828			!codex.CapabilityDescriptor.ReleasePolicy.Enabled {
   829			t.Fatalf("Provider Host summary advertised an unexpected Runtime Event range: %#v", providers["codex"])
   830		}
   831	}

  1248	func providerHostTestRuntime(provider, mode string) map[string]any {

  1251			"versionSource": "probe",

  1272			runtime["compatible"] = false

  1291	func TestProviderHostV2HelperProcess(t *testing.T) {
  1292		if !containsString(os.Args, providerHostTestHelperArgument) {
  1293			return
  1294		}
  1295		for _, entry := range providerHostTestExpectedEnvironment() {
  1296			name, value, found := strings.Cut(entry, "=")
  1297			if !found || os.Getenv(name) != value {
  1298				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Provider Host runtime environment %s = %q, want %q\n", name, os.Getenv(name), value)
  1299				os.Exit(2)
  1300			}
  1301		}
  1302		for _, name := range []string{
  1303			"GO_WANT_PROVIDER_HOST_HELPER", "PROVIDER_HOST_TEST_MODE", "PROVIDER_HOST_TEST_COMMAND_LOG", "PROVIDER_HOST_TEST_EXIT_MARKER",
  1304			"SYNARA_PROVIDER_HOST_BUILD_VERSION",
  1305			"SECRET", "HOST_SECRET", "SYNARA_HOST_SECRET", "SYNARA_AUTH_TOKEN", "SYNARA_WORKER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN",
  1306			"SYNARA_AGENTD_ASSIGNED_EXECUTION_ID", "SYNARA_LEASE_TOKEN", "SYNARA_CONTROL_PLANE_URL",
  1307			"OPENAI_API_KEY", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY",
  1308			"GITHUB_TOKEN", "GH_TOKEN", "DATABASE_URL", "PGPASSWORD", "POSTGRES_PASSWORD",
  1309			"S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD", "GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS", "AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET",
  1310			"HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "NO_PROXY", "SSH_AUTH_SOCK", "NODE_OPTIONS",
  1311		} {
  1312			if os.Getenv(name) != "" {
  1313				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "ambient secret environment leaked to Provider Host:", name)
  1314				os.Exit(2)
  1315			}
  1316		}
  1317		credentialDelivered := false
  1318		if fd := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("SYNARA_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_FD")); fd != "" {
  1319			file := os.NewFile(3, "provider-credential")
  1320			var credential RunnerCredential
  1321			if file == nil || json.NewDecoder(file).Decode(&credential) != nil || credential.Payload["apiKey"] != "provider-secret" {
  1322				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Provider credential was not delivered through FD 3")
  1323				os.Exit(2)
  1324			}
  1325			_ = file.Close()
  1326			credentialDelivered = true
  1327		}
  1328	
  1329		mode := providerHostTestArgument(providerHostTestModeArgument)
  1330		commandLog := providerHostTestArgument(providerHostTestCommandLogArgument)
  1331		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
  1332		encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
  1333		var pendingSend *providerHostCommand
  1334		runtimeOutputDirectory := ""
  1335		providerStateDirectory := ""
  1336		for scanner.Scan() {
  1337			var command providerHostCommand
  1338			if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &command); err != nil {
  1339				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
  1340				os.Exit(2)
  1341			}
  1342			if commandLog != "" {
  1343				file, err := os.OpenFile(commandLog, os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
  1344				if err != nil {
  1345					fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
  1346					os.Exit(2)
  1347				}
  1348				_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(file, command.CommandType)
  1349				_ = file.Close()
  1350			}
  1351			if mode == "malformed" && command.CommandType == "Describe" {
  1352				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, "{not-json")
  1353				continue
  1354			}
  1355			if mode == "crash" && command.CommandType == "Describe" {
  1356				fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "simulated Host crash")
  1357				os.Exit(23)
  1358			}
  1359			if mode == "oversized" && command.CommandType == "Describe" {
  1360				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "{\"padding\":\"%s\"}\n", strings.Repeat("x", 2<<10))
  1361				continue
  1362			}
  1363			switch command.CommandType {
  1364			case "Describe":
  1365				provider, _ := command.Payload["provider"].(string)
  1366				capabilities := map[string]any{
  1367					"send-turn": "native", "steer-turn": "native", "compact": "native", "review": "native",
  1368				}
  1369				if mode == "missing-capability" {
  1370					capabilities = map[string]any{"send-turn": "unsupported"}
  1371				}
  1372				major := providerHostProtocolMajor
  1373				if mode == "incompatible-major" {
  1374					major = 3
  1375				}
  1376				minor := providerHostProtocolMinor
  1377				if mode == "protocol-2.0" {
  1378					minor = 0
  1379				}
  1380				supportTier := "experimental"
  1381				requiresExplicitEnablement := true
  1382				enabled := providerHostTestExperimentalProviderEnabled(provider)
  1383				if mode == "local-only-policy-enabled" || mode == "local-only-policy-disabled" {
  1384					supportTier = "local-only"
  1385					requiresExplicitEnablement = false
  1386					enabled = mode == "local-only-policy-enabled"
  1387				}
  1388				if mode == "policy-mismatch" {
  1389					enabled = !enabled
  1390				}
  1391				capabilityDescriptor := map[string]any{
  1392					"provider": provider, "supportTier": supportTier, "adapterVersion": "test-adapter",
  1393					"providerCliVersion": "test-cli", "capabilities": capabilities,
  1394				}
  1395				if mode == "missing-provider-cli-version" {
  1396					delete(capabilityDescriptor, "providerCliVersion")
  1397				}
  1398				descriptor := map[string]any{
  1399					"protocolVersion":  map[string]any{"major": major, "minor": minor, "futureMinorField": true},
  1400					"hostBuildVersion": "test-host", "maximumCommandBytes": providerHostCommandLimit,
  1401					"maximumMessageBytes":     1 << 20,
  1402					"runtimeEventVersions":    providerHostTestRuntimeEventVersions(mode),
  1403					"credentialDeliveryModes": []string{"anonymous-fd"},
  1404					"resumeStrategies":        []string{"native-cursor", "authoritative-history"},
  1405					"capabilityDescriptor":    capabilityDescriptor,
  1406				}
  1407				if minor >= 1 {
  1408					runtime := providerHostTestRuntime(provider, mode)
  1409					releasePolicy := map[string]any{
  1410						"requiresExplicitEnablement": requiresExplicitEnablement,
  1411						"enabled":                    enabled,
  1412					}
  1413					if mode == "root-runtime-policy" {
  1414						descriptor["runtime"] = runtime
  1415						descriptor["releasePolicy"] = releasePolicy
  1416					} else {
  1417						capabilityDescriptor["runtime"] = runtime
  1418						capabilityDescriptor["releasePolicy"] = releasePolicy
  1419					}
  1420				}
  1421				emitProviderHostTestMessage(encoder, command, "Result", map[string]any{
  1422					"descriptor": descriptor,
  1423				}, nil)
  1424			case "StartSession", "ResumeSession":
  1425				if version, ok := integerField(command.Payload, "runtimeEventVersion"); !ok || version != 2 {
  1426					fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Runtime Event negotiation was not carried into the session command")
  1427					os.Exit(2)
  1428				}
  1429				if runnerInput, ok := command.Payload["runnerInput"].(map[string]any); ok {
  1430					runtimeOutputDirectory, _ = runnerInput["runtimeOutputDirectory"].(string)
  1431					providerStateDirectory, _ = runnerInput["providerStateDirectory"].(string)
  1432				}
  1433				if credentialDelivered && strings.TrimSpace(providerStateDirectory) == "" {
  1434					fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Provider state directory was not carried into the session command")
  1435					os.Exit(2)
  1436				}
  1437				emitProviderHostTestMessage(encoder, command, "Result", map[string]any{"started": true}, nil)
  1438			case "SendTurn":
  1439				if version, ok := integerField(command.Payload, "runtimeEventVersion"); !ok || version != 2 {
  1440					fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Runtime Event negotiation was not carried into SendTurn")
  1441					os.Exit(2)
  1442				}
  1443				if mode == "provider-error" {
  1444					retryable, yes, no := true, true, false
  1445					emitProviderHostTestMessage(encoder, command, "Error", nil, &providerHostWireError{
  1446						Code: "provider_rate_limited", Message: "Provider is rate limited", Retryable: &retryable,
  1447						RequiresNewExecution: &yes, RequiresUserAction: &no,
  1448						CanReconstructFromHistory: &yes, CanMoveWorker: &yes,
  1449					})
  1450					continue

   608	func descriptorFromResult(message providerHostMessage) (providerHostDescriptor, error) {
   609		if message.MessageType != "Result" {
   610			return providerHostDescriptor{}, protocolFailure("Describe did not return a Result message")
   611		}
   612		value, ok := message.Payload["descriptor"]
   613		if !ok {
   614			return providerHostDescriptor{}, protocolFailure("Describe Result omitted descriptor")
   615		}
   616		encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
   617		if err != nil {
   618			return providerHostDescriptor{}, protocolFailure("Describe descriptor is not encodable")
   619		}
   620		var descriptor providerHostDescriptor
   621		if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &descriptor); err != nil {
   622			return providerHostDescriptor{}, protocolFailure("Describe descriptor is invalid")
   623		}
   624		return descriptor, nil
   625	}
   626	
   627	func (r *Runner) validateProviderHostDescriptorWire(descriptor providerHostDescriptor, requestedProvider string) error {
   628		if descriptor.ProtocolVersion.Major != providerHostProtocolMajor {
   629			return &runnerFailure{
   630				code:                 "provider_version_incompatible",
   631				message:              fmt.Sprintf("Provider Host Protocol major %d is not supported", descriptor.ProtocolVersion.Major),
   632				requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true,
   633				canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   634			}
   635		}
   636		if descriptor.ProtocolVersion.Minor < 0 || strings.TrimSpace(descriptor.HostBuildVersion) == "" ||
   637			strings.TrimSpace(descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.Provider) == "" ||
   638			strings.TrimSpace(descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.SupportTier) == "" ||
   639			strings.TrimSpace(descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.AdapterVersion) == "" ||
   640			descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.Capabilities == nil || descriptor.MaximumCommandBytes <= 0 ||
   641			descriptor.MaximumMessageBytes <= 0 || descriptor.RuntimeEventVersions.Minimum <= 0 ||
   642			descriptor.RuntimeEventVersions.Maximum < descriptor.RuntimeEventVersions.Minimum {
   643			return protocolFailure("Provider Host descriptor omitted required compatibility fields")
   644		}
   645		if normalizeProvider(descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.Provider) != normalizeProvider(requestedProvider) {
   646			return protocolFailure("Provider Host descriptor does not match the requested Provider")
   647		}
   648		if !validProviderSupportTier(descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.SupportTier) {
   649			return protocolFailure("Provider Host descriptor uses an invalid support tier")
   650		}
   651		if descriptor.RuntimeEventVersions.Minimum > providerHostRuntimeEventVersion ||
   652			descriptor.RuntimeEventVersions.Maximum < providerHostRuntimeEventVersion {
   653			return &runnerFailure{
   654				code:                 "provider_version_incompatible",
   655				message:              "Provider Host does not support Runtime Event version 2",
   656				requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true,
   657				canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   658			}
   659		}
   660		if descriptor.ProtocolVersion.Minor >= 1 {
   661			if descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.Runtime == nil || descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.ReleasePolicy == nil {
   662				return protocolFailure("Provider Host Protocol 2.1 descriptor omitted runtime or releasePolicy")
   663			}
   664			if err := validateProviderRuntimeDescriptor(*descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.Runtime); err != nil {
   665				return err
   666			}
   667			if err := r.validateProviderReleasePolicy(
   668				requestedProvider, descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.SupportTier, *descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.ReleasePolicy,
   669			); err != nil {
   670				return err
   671			}
   672		} else if descriptor.CapabilityDescriptor.SupportTier == "experimental" {
   673			return &runnerFailure{
   674				code:                 "provider_version_incompatible",
   675				message:              "Experimental Providers require Provider Host Protocol 2.1 release policy metadata",
   676				requiresNewExecution: true, requiresUserAction: true,
   677				canReconstructFromHistory: true, canMoveWorker: true,
   678			}
   679		}
   680		return nil
   681	}
   682	
   683	func validateProviderRuntimeDescriptor(runtime providerRuntimeDescriptor) error {
   684		if runtime.Kind != "cli" && runtime.Kind != "sdk" && runtime.Kind != "local" {
   685			return protocolFailure("Provider Host runtime kind is invalid")
   686		}
   687		if strings.TrimSpace(runtime.Name) == "" ||
   688			(runtime.VersionSource != "probe" && runtime.VersionSource != "package" && runtime.VersionSource != "build") ||
   689			strings.TrimSpace(runtime.CompatibleRange.MinimumInclusive) == "" ||
   690			(runtime.CompatibleRange.MaximumExclusive != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*runtime.CompatibleRange.MaximumExclusive) == "") {
   691			return protocolFailure("Provider Host runtime metadata is incomplete")
   692		}
   693		if runtime.Version != nil && strings.TrimSpace(*runtime.Version) == "" {
   694			return protocolFailure("Provider Host runtime version is empty")
   695		}
   696		if !runtime.Available && runtime.Compatible {
   697			return protocolFailure("Unavailable Provider Host runtime cannot be compatible")
   698		}
   699		if runtime.Version == nil && runtime.Compatible {
   700			return protocolFailure("Provider Host runtime without a version cannot be compatible")
   701		}
   702		return nil
   703	}

  1579	func (d *Daemon) retryInteractionDeliveryUpdate(
  1580		ctx context.Context,
  1581		update func(context.Context) error,
  1582	) error {
  1583		var lastErr error
  1584		for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
  1585			requestContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, d.config.RequestTimeout)
  1586			lastErr = update(requestContext)
  1587			cancel()
  1588			if lastErr == nil {
  1589				return nil
  1590			}
  1591			if attempt < 2 && !waitContext(ctx, time.Duration(attempt+1)*100*time.Millisecond) {
  1592				return ctx.Err()
  1593			}
  1594		}
  1595		return lastErr
  1596	}

  1598	func canonicalInteractionRuntimeEvent(message RunnerMessage) (RunnerMessage, error) {
  1599		if message.EventVersion != executions.RuntimeEventVersionV2 {
  1600			return RunnerMessage{}, protocolFailure("Provider Host InteractionRequest did not use the negotiated Runtime Event version")
  1601		}
  1602		requestID, _ := message.Payload["requestId"].(string)
  1603		requestID = strings.TrimSpace(requestID)
  1604		if requestID == "" || len(requestID) > 200 || strings.ContainsAny(requestID, "\r\n\t") {
  1605			return RunnerMessage{}, protocolFailure("Provider Host InteractionRequest omitted a valid requestId")
  1606		}
  1607		payload := make(map[string]any, len(message.Payload)+2)
  1608		for key, value := range message.Payload {
  1609			payload[key] = value
  1610		}
  1900		}
  1901		defer source.Close()
  1902		rootPath, _, err := workspaceArtifactPath(workspaceDirectory, relative)
  1903		if err != nil {
  1904			return "", err
  1905		}
  1906		return filepath.Join(rootPath, relative), nil
  1907	}

  1909	func drainRenewError(channel <-chan error) error {
  1910		for err := range channel {
  1911			if err != nil {
  1912				return err
  1913			}
  1914		}
  1915		return nil
  1916	}

  1918	func waitContext(ctx context.Context, duration time.Duration) bool {
  1919		timer := time.NewTimer(duration)
  1920		defer timer.Stop()
  1921		select {
  1922		case <-ctx.Done():
  1923			return false
  1924		case <-timer.C:
  1925			return true
  1926		}
  1927	}

package providercatalog

import "strings"

type CompatibleRange struct {
	MinimumInclusive string
	MaximumExclusive string
}

type RuntimePolicy struct {
	Kind            string
	Name            string
	VersionSource   string
	CompatibleRange CompatibleRange
}

type Provider struct {
	Name           string
	SupportTier    string
	AdapterVersion string
	RuntimePolicy  RuntimePolicy
	Capabilities   map[string]string
}

func ProviderNames() []string {
	return append([]string(nil), generatedProviderNames...)
}

func CapabilityIDs() []string {
	return append([]string(nil), generatedCapabilityIDs...)
}

func Providers() []Provider {
	result := make([]Provider, len(generatedProviders))
	for index := range generatedProviders {
		result[index] = cloneProvider(generatedProviders[index])
	}
	return result
}

func Lookup(name string) (Provider, bool) {
	provider, found := generatedProviderByName[name]
	if !found {
		return Provider{}, false
	}
	return cloneProvider(provider), true
}

func CanonicalName(value string) (string, bool) {
	normalized := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
	if normalized == "gemini" {
		return "antigravity", true
	}
	canonical, found := generatedCanonicalProviderNames[normalized]
	return canonical, found
}

func CapabilitySupport(provider, capabilityID string) (string, bool) {
	entry, found := generatedProviderByName[provider]
	if !found {
		return "", false
	}
	support, found := entry.Capabilities[capabilityID]
	return support, found
}

func cloneProvider(provider Provider) Provider {
	provider.Capabilities = cloneCapabilities(provider.Capabilities)
	return provider
}

func cloneCapabilities(capabilities map[string]string) map[string]string {
	result := make(map[string]string, len(capabilities))
	for capabilityID, support := range capabilities {
		result[capabilityID] = support
	}
	return result
}

    27	func TestLegacyRunnerCancellationTerminatesDescendants(t *testing.T) {
    28		ready, sentinel := processTreeTestPaths(t)
    29		t.Setenv(processTreeTestModeEnv, "root")
    30		t.Setenv(processTreeTestReadyEnv, ready)
    31		t.Setenv(processTreeTestSentinelEnv, sentinel)
    32		runner := &Runner{
    33			command:         processTreeRunnerTestCommand(),
    34			maxMessageBytes: 1 << 20,
    35			protocol:        RunnerProtocolV1,
    36		}
    37		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
    38		defer cancel()
    39		workspace := t.TempDir()
    40		result := make(chan error, 1)
    41		go func() {
    42			_, err := runner.Run(ctx, RunnerInput{WorkspaceDirectory: workspace}, nil, func(context.Context, RunnerMessage) error {
    43				return nil
    44			})
    45			result <- err
    46		}()
    47	
    48		waitForProcessTreeReady(t, ready)
    49		cancel()
    50		select {
    51		case err := <-result:
    52			if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
    53				t.Fatalf("legacy Runner returned %v after cancellation", err)
    54			}
    55		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
    56			t.Fatal("legacy Runner did not terminate after cancellation")
    57		}
    58		assertProcessTreeSentinelAbsent(t, sentinel)
    59	}

codex
The implementation seam is now clear: keep the warm-host lifecycle in a small agentd-internal manager, cache all live-process `Describe` results, and let the existing runner consume exactly one cached descriptor. The credential pipe will be created before spawn but its writer will wait for either adoption (write) or teardown (close without writing). The current descriptor checks will be moved as one shared block used by both adopted and normal-spawn paths.

+package agentd
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/google/uuid"
+
+	"github.com/synara-ai/synara/services/control-plane/internal/executions"
+)
+
+const providerHostPrestartMaximumAttempts = 3
+
+type providerHostV2Prestart struct {
+	process     *providerHostV2Process
+	descriptors map[string]providerHostDescriptor
+	released    chan struct{}
+	releaseOnce sync.Once
+}
+
+func (p *providerHostV2Prestart) release() {
+	p.releaseOnce.Do(func() { close(p.released) })
+}
+
+type providerHostV2PrestartManager struct {
+	runner         *Runner
+	ctx            context.Context
+	cancel         context.CancelFunc
+	requestTimeout time.Duration
+
+	mu       sync.Mutex
+	host     *providerHostV2Prestart
+	finished bool
+	ready    chan struct{}
+	readyOnce sync.Once
+	done     chan struct{}
+}
+
+type providerHostV2Adoption struct {
+	process             *providerHostV2Process
+	runtimeEventVersion int
+}
+
+func providerHostPrestartEnabled(config Config) bool {
+	return effectiveWorkerMode(config) == executions.WorkerModeWarmPool &&
+		strings.TrimSpace(config.CgroupV2Root) == "" &&
+		config.RunnerProtocol == RunnerProtocolV2
+}
+
+func (r *Runner) providerPrestartExecutionID() uuid.UUID {
+	namespace := r.instanceUID
+	if namespace == uuid.Nil {
+		namespace = uuid.NameSpaceOID
+	}
+	return uuid.NewSHA1(namespace, []byte("synara-provider-prestart"))
+}
+
+func (r *Runner) startProviderHostV2Prestart(ctx context.Context, requestTimeout time.Duration) {
+	prestartContext, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
+	manager := &providerHostV2PrestartManager{
+		runner: r, ctx: prestartContext, cancel: cancel, requestTimeout: requestTimeout,
+		ready: make(chan struct{}), done: make(chan struct{}),
+	}
+	r.prestartMu.Lock()
+	if r.providerHostPrestart != nil {
+		r.prestartMu.Unlock()
+		cancel()
+		return
+	}
+	r.providerHostPrestart = manager
+	r.prestartMu.Unlock()
+	go manager.run()
+	select {
+	case <-manager.ready:
+	case <-manager.done:
+	case <-ctx.Done():
+	}
+}
+
+func (r *Runner) stopProviderHostV2Prestart() {
+	r.prestartMu.Lock()
+	manager := r.providerHostPrestart
+	r.providerHostPrestart = nil
+	r.prestartMu.Unlock()
+	if manager != nil {
+		manager.stop()
+	}
+}
+
+func (r *Runner) takeProviderHostV2Prestart(
+	input RunnerInput,
+	credential *RunnerCredential,
+) (providerHostV2Adoption, bool, string) {
+	r.prestartMu.Lock()
+	manager := r.providerHostPrestart
+	r.providerHostPrestart = nil
+	r.prestartMu.Unlock()
+	if manager == nil {
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, false, ""
+	}
+	adoption, reason := manager.take(input, credential)
+	return adoption, true, reason
+}
+
+func (m *providerHostV2PrestartManager) run() {
+	defer func() {
+		m.mu.Lock()
+		m.finished = true
+		m.mu.Unlock()
+		m.readyOnce.Do(func() { close(m.ready) })
+		close(m.done)
+	}()
+	for attempt := 0; attempt < providerHostPrestartMaximumAttempts; attempt++ {
+		if attempt > 0 && !waitContext(m.ctx, time.Duration(attempt)*100*time.Millisecond) {
+			return
+		}
+		attemptContext := m.ctx
+		cancelAttempt := func() {}
+		if m.requestTimeout > 0 {
+			attemptContext, cancelAttempt = context.WithTimeout(m.ctx, m.requestTimeout)
+		}
+		host, err := m.runner.prestartProviderHostV2(attemptContext)
+		cancelAttempt()
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		m.mu.Lock()
+		if m.ctx.Err() != nil {
+			m.mu.Unlock()
+			_ = host.process.abort()
+			return
+		}
+		m.host = host
+		m.mu.Unlock()
+		m.readyOnce.Do(func() { close(m.ready) })
+
+		select {
+		case <-m.ctx.Done():
+			if m.remove(host) {
+				_ = host.process.abort()
+			}
+			return
+		case <-host.released:
+			return
+		case <-host.process.readerDone:
+			if !m.remove(host) {
+				return
+			}
+			_ = host.process.abort()
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func (m *providerHostV2PrestartManager) remove(host *providerHostV2Prestart) bool {
+	m.mu.Lock()
+	defer m.mu.Unlock()
+	if m.host != host {
+		return false
+	}
+	m.host = nil
+	return true
+}
+
+func (m *providerHostV2PrestartManager) take(
+	input RunnerInput,
+	credential *RunnerCredential,
+) (providerHostV2Adoption, string) {
+	m.mu.Lock()
+	host := m.host
+	if host != nil {
+		m.host = nil
+		host.release()
+	}
+	finished := m.finished
+	m.mu.Unlock()
+	if host == nil {
+		m.stop()
+		if finished {
+			return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "retries-exhausted"
+		}
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "not-ready"
+	}
+	m.cancel()
+	<-m.done
+	if !host.process.availableForAdoption() {
+		_ = host.process.abort()
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "process-exited"
+	}
+	descriptor, found := host.descriptors[normalizeProvider(input.Workload.Provider)]
+	if !found {
+		_ = host.process.abort()
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "provider-not-described"
+	}
+	runtimeEventVersion, err := m.runner.configureProviderHostV2ForExecution(
+		host.process, descriptor, input, credential,
+	)
+	if err != nil {
+		_ = host.process.abort()
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "descriptor-mismatch"
+	}
+	if err := host.process.deliverCredential(credential); err != nil {
+		_ = host.process.abort()
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "credential-delivery"
+	}
+	return providerHostV2Adoption{
+		process: host.process, runtimeEventVersion: runtimeEventVersion,
+	}, "adopted"
+}
+
+func (m *providerHostV2PrestartManager) stop() {
+	m.cancel()
+	<-m.done
+}
+
+func (r *Runner) prestartProviderHostV2(ctx context.Context) (host *providerHostV2Prestart, err error) {
+	process, err := r.startProviderHostV2DeferredCredential(ctx, r.providerPrestartExecutionID(), 1)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	owned := true
+	defer func() {
+		if owned {
+			err = errors.Join(err, process.abort())
+		}
+	}()
+	descriptors := make(map[string]providerHostDescriptor, len(providerHostProviders))
+	executionID := r.providerPrestartExecutionID().String()
+	for _, provider := range providerHostProviders {
+		command := newProviderHostCommand(
+			executionID, 1, "Describe", "worker-prestart:"+provider,
+			map[string]any{"provider": provider},
+		)
+		terminal, executeErr := process.executeContext(ctx, command, nil)
+		if executeErr != nil {
+			return nil, executeErr
+		}
+		descriptor, descriptorErr := descriptorFromResult(terminal)
+		if descriptorErr != nil {
+			return nil, descriptorErr
+		}
+		if validateErr := r.validateProviderHostDescriptorWire(descriptor, provider); validateErr != nil {
+			return nil, validateErr
+		}
+		descriptors[normalizeProvider(provider)] = descriptor
+	}
+	owned = false
+	return &providerHostV2Prestart{
+		process: process, descriptors: descriptors, released: make(chan struct{}),
+	}, nil
+}

+		}
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "not-ready"
+	}
+	m.cancel()
+	<-m.done
+	if !host.process.availableForAdoption() {
+		_ = host.process.abort()
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "process-exited"
+	}
+	descriptor, found := host.descriptors[normalizeProvider(input.Workload.Provider)]
+	if !found {
+		_ = host.process.abort()
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "provider-not-described"
+	}
+	runtimeEventVersion, err := m.runner.configureProviderHostV2ForExecution(
+		host.process, descriptor, input, credential,
+	)
+	if err != nil {
+		_ = host.process.abort()
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "descriptor-mismatch"
+	}
+	if err := host.process.deliverCredential(credential); err != nil {
+		_ = host.process.abort()
+		return providerHostV2Adoption{}, "credential-delivery"
+	}
+	return providerHostV2Adoption{
+		process: host.process, runtimeEventVersion: runtimeEventVersion,
+	}, "adopted"
+}
+
+func (m *providerHostV2PrestartManager) stop() {
+	m.cancel()
+	<-m.done
+}
+
+func (r *Runner) prestartProviderHostV2(ctx context.Context) (host *providerHostV2Prestart, err error) {
+	process, err := r.startProviderHostV2DeferredCredential(ctx, r.providerPrestartExecutionID(), 1)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	owned := true
+	defer func() {
+		if owned {
+			err = errors.Join(err, process.abort())
+		}
+	}()
+	descriptors := make(map[string]providerHostDescriptor, len(providerHostProviders))
+	executionID := r.providerPrestartExecutionID().String()
+	for _, provider := range providerHostProviders {
+		command := newProviderHostCommand(
+			executionID, 1, "Describe", "worker-prestart:"+provider,
+			map[string]any{"provider": provider},
+		)
+		terminal, executeErr := process.executeContext(ctx, command, nil)
+		if executeErr != nil {
+			return nil, executeErr
+		}
+		descriptor, descriptorErr := descriptorFromResult(terminal)
+		if descriptorErr != nil {
+			return nil, descriptorErr
+		}
+		if validateErr := r.validateProviderHostDescriptorWire(descriptor, provider); validateErr != nil {
+			return nil, validateErr
+		}
+		descriptors[normalizeProvider(provider)] = descriptor
+	}
+	owned = false
+	return &providerHostV2Prestart{
+		process: process, descriptors: descriptors, released: make(chan struct{}),
+	}, nil

+type providerHostV2PrestartManager struct {

+func providerHostPrestartEnabled(config Config) bool {
+	return effectiveWorkerMode(config) == executions.WorkerModeWarmPool &&
+		strings.TrimSpace(config.CgroupV2Root) == "" &&
+		config.RunnerProtocol == RunnerProtocolV2

+func (r *Runner) providerPrestartExecutionID() uuid.UUID {
+	namespace := r.instanceUID
+	if namespace == uuid.Nil {
+		namespace = uuid.NameSpaceOID
+	}
+	return uuid.NewSHA1(namespace, []byte("synara-provider-prestart"))
+}
